articles.title: Julius Baer ten-month adjusted pre-tax profit rises 17% on AuM growth
articles.summary: The asset base expanded 6% from the end of 2025, buoyed by net new money of SFr8.5bn, despite ongoing portfolio de-risking.

articles.title: Julius Baer Profit Climbs as Inflows Boost Assets Under Management
articles.summary: Assets under management in the first 10 months of the year were boosted by a solid stock market performance, a stronger dollar and client money inflows.

articles.title: U.S. Inflation Makes Further Fed Rate Rise in December Inevitable
articles.summary: U.S. inflation remains too high for the Federal Reserve, making an interest-rate hike at the December FOMC meeting virtually inevitable, Julius Baer Chief Economist David Kohl said in a note.

articles.title: Julius Baer rejigs Middle East and Africa leadership
articles.summary: Both executives report to region emerging markets head Rahul Malhotra.

articles.title: Julius Baer names two new board nominees
articles.summary: The nominees are Caroline Kuhnert as well as Elaine Arden.

articles.title: One Final Fed Hike This Year? Julius Baer Reportedly Sees December Move As Treasury Yields Hover Near 24-Year Highs
articles.summary: According to Barron’s, Julius Baer’s Kohl said financial conditions have tightened since the Fed's September meeting mainly through higher long-term yields and dollar strength, not the rate increase itself.

articles.title: One Final Rate Hike for Fed This Year
articles.summary: The Federal Reserve is expected to deliver one final rate hike in December, followed by an extended pause, according to Julius Baer Chief Economist David Kohl.

articles.title: Julius Baer to buy back up to CHF600 mln in shares after regulatory scrutiny
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Julius Baer on Friday said it would buy back up to 600 million Swiss francs of its own shares, as it seeks to move past regulatory scrutiny and legacy issues that have weighed on the business.

articles.summary: Price targets for Julius Bär Gruppe have converged in a tight CHF 80 to CHF 81 range, with several firms guiding into the CHF high 70s to low 80s. Recent analyst commentary links these levels to the end of FINMA enforcement, a reset in revenue expectations and a more balanced view of risk and execution. articles.title: Morgan Stanley upgrades Julius Baer after FINMA ends AML enforcement action
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley upgraded Swiss private bank Julius Baer to "equal-weight" from "underweight" and raised its price target to CHF 81 from CHF 67 after Swiss regulator FINMA ended enforcement action against the bank over anti-money laundering breaches.
